name: ALOE SOCOTRINA
key_symptoms: Aversion to meat. Longing for juicy things. After eating, flatulence, pulsation in rectum and sexual irritation. Nausea, with headache. Pain in pit when making false step.

Headache alternates with lumbago, with intestinal and uterine affections. Disinclination to mental labor. Aches above forehead, with heaviness in eyes, must partially close them. Headache after stool. Dull, pressive pain; worse from heat.
Winter coughs, with itching. Difficult respiration, with stitches from liver to chest.
Lameness in all limbs. Drawing pains in joints. Soles pain when walking.
Pain in small of back; worse moving. Stitches through sacrum. Lumbago alternating with headache and piles.
